claim_limits: Accepted L1a discretization emulation only; not physical truth.
No material, plasma, thermal, structural, propulsion or hardware accuracy.
V1-v7 outcomes are immutable; v7 development artifacts are the sole scientific development evidence and provide no v8 labels.

execution.attestation_order: detached/commit/dependency/remote/global-clean verification before runtime construction; prebundle consumes immutable verification
execution.git_common_namespace_lock: persistent atomic attempt-1 claim under the repository Git common directory, created with shared runtime pinned filesystem primitives before ExperimentRuntime construction
execution.runtime_drift_policy: tracked or staged changes forbidden globally; untracked entries allowed only under exact results and .runtime-cache roots

fidelities.coarse_source_transfer: conservative integration of unchanged physical bands over coarse dual cells

integrity.line_endings: experiment-local .gitattributes pins LF text and binary NPZ
integrity.protocol_subject: preregister L1a field surrogate v8 experiment
integrity.results_subject: record L1a field surrogate v8 results

models.alignment: polarity-canonical piecewise input-only map through axis bounds, chamber endpoints and every stage centre
models.ard_fit: deterministic candidate-only grouped 3-fold CV then marginal-likelihood tie-break; no correlation heuristic
models.coefficient_features: dedicated low-field joint basis coefficients plus geometry; singular-value-whitened residual coefficients and per-mode ridge regularization
models.pod: stage-local joint multi-view windowed residual basis: cylindrical-energy channel, unweighted axial windows, explicit axis-Bz channel
models.scalar_features: one relevant observed coarse QOI per output; source representation error additionally uses preregistered radial/axial grid-phase sin/cos features
models.scalar_suitability: candidate-only absolute Pearson coarse/high correlation >=0.8; unsuitable targets derived from reconstructed field or rejected
models.scalar_target: per-output standardized transformed high-minus-low discrepancy with fitted constant mean

sampling.candidate_prefix: 18 stage/stratum/polarity cells in deterministic maximin rounds; budgets 162/216/270 end after 9/12/15 rows per cell
sampling.geometry_selection: input-only valid geometry stratification and balanced maximin selection over 1024 screened fresh rows
sampling.role_balance: each role balances stage counts 3/4/5, interpolation/boundary/OOD, and both canonical polarities; odd cell counts differ by at most one polarity row
